title: Multi-type $Λ$-Wright--Fisher processes with polynomial drift: Bernstein duality, long-term behaviour, and simulation of moments
summary: The $(d+1)$-type $Λ$-Wright--Fisher process with polynomial drift is a Lévy-type process on the $d$-dimensional unit simplex whose generator entails a particular jump and diffusive component, as well as a polynomial drift component. In this work, the process is connected to a (Bernstein) dual process, which admits an interpretation as an urn model with coloured balls.
